teaser: PHP October 2026, update 4: still no confirmed victim, one repository becomes six, the cutover, and faster agent tools.
core_idea: Five days after php2shell, no named organisation says it was compromised, and the advice shifts to checking for past break-ins; meanwhile the PHP story site split from one repository into six, by who writes and how often, cutting a release from a median of 88 seconds to 25 to 42, froze the old repository, moved its main address to the new build, and upgraded its agents to a faster sgit, while the pages still wait on one build and a token only the editor can set.

figures.caption: The PHP site's front page at its main address, edition v0.22.32, after the cutover of 26 October: the line under the masthead says "You're viewing this as an Executive" and offers six other ways to read it, and the thirty-second answer says that, as of 12:14 UTC on 26 October, no named organisation has said it was broken into through this flaw.

One repository into six, as split on 25 October 2026: press, the scaffolding, at press.php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai; data, the API, every version immutable with a sha256 manifest; team, the operations; and the three page sites, site at the main address, refs for the references and updates for the regular updates, each pinning a data version and a press version.

What the split buys, measured by dev on 25 October 2026: a CI run from push to live took a median of 88 seconds in the one repository and 25 to 42 seconds in the six; the gate step 70 to 132 seconds against 0.1 to 7; a release rewrote a median of 1,809 files against about 470 to 550 per cut, and 1 for a run record; checking a change to the references took about 75 seconds against 7.

The data host, data.php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai, at version 0.1.39: every version immutable once published at its own address, the newest at /latest/, and each version's manifest listing every file with its sha256 and its schema.

sgit 0.25.0 in the newsroom, measured by the researcher on its source watch vault of 79,465 files and 2.7 GB on 26 October 2026: commit phase 1 from 12 minutes 38 seconds to 25 seconds; push from 4 minutes 16 seconds to 67 seconds; the data export from 9 minutes to 34 seconds; the whole pass from 57 minutes to 35.

The control room at edition v0.22.32: data 2 hours old and ageing, 2 agents blocked, 17 items waiting on the editor, 4 decisions, 16 branches ahead with 43 commits, and the pipeline from researcher to desk, with the ontologist, the librarian and the desk flagged for leaving no run record in 24 hours.
